## README.md
> **This dataset has moved.** It is now published, updated and extended as [Field blocks for The Netherlands](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/nl_block) in the [Harmonized Field Boundary Data](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data) catalog. The files here are no longer updated.

# Field boundaries for The Netherlands

Provides the official agricultural reference field boundaries of The Netherlands.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from a geopackage that was provided by the state.

- **Source Data Provider:** [Rijksdienst voor Ondernemers / PDOK](https://www.pdok.nl/introductie/-/article/referentiepercelen)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **Homepage:** https://www.pdok.nl/introductie/-/article/referentiepercelen

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/nl-ref/nl_ref.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/nl-ref/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/nl-ref/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/nl-ref/nl_ref.pmtiles)


### Columns

The Reference Parcel dataset has the following properties:

| Property               | **Data Type** | Description                                |
|------------------------|---------------|--------------------------------------------|
| id                     | integer       | Identifier                                 |
| area                   | string        | Source (digital source, e.g. aerial photo) |
| source                 | string        | aerial photo or other                      |
| determination_datetime | datetime      |                                            |

## Lineage

- Data downloaded on 2024-06-12 from https://service.pdok.nl/rvo/referentiepercelen/atom/downloads/referentiepercelen.gpkg
- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.4.0
